description: Form 8582-CR line 6 (I8582-CR: 'A. Taxable income including net passive income ... B. Tax on line A ... C. Taxable income without net passive income ... D. Tax on line C'). Single, wages $100,000, a passive business with $20,000 of income and a $1,000 credit. Taxable income 120,000 − 15,750 = 104,250: tax 1,192.50 + 4,386 + 12,072.50 + 216 = $17,867. Without the $20,000: 84,250, Tax Table row 84,250–84,300 = $13,455. Line 6 = $4,412 ≥ $1,000, so the credit is allowed; Form 3800 allows it (tentative minimum tax 26% x (120,000 − 88,100) = 8,294 < 17,867), and tax after credits is $16,867.
